'''Sith Juggernauts''' were [[Sith Warrior]]s who fought for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed it circa [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Holonet-Sith Warrior">{{Holonet|classes|sith-warrior|Sith Warrior}}</ref>

These [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] specialized in combat endurance and were known for wearing [[Sith apparel|armor]] that provided them special protection in battle. Sith Juggernauts were known to primarily wield one lightsaber in combat, and were frequently adept at using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to cause [[Mind trick/Legends#Force_fear|terror and despair]] in enemy combatants.<ref name="FanFriday">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref> Sith Juggernauts usually had an intense muscle build, which helped them physically when using a lightsaber or in combat.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Juggernaut is an advanced class for the [[Sith Warrior]] class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMORPG video game. This advanced class specializes in the use of heavy armor and greater stamina in battle.<ref name="FanFriday" /> The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]].<ref name="Holonet-Jedi Knight">{{Holonet|classes|jedi-knight|Jedi Knight}}</ref>
It appears the Sith Juggernaut is based on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], due to great strength, heavy armor, single saber, and powerful Force powers. Officially though, the juggernaut is based on [[Marka Ragnos]].
